sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the revisionist against the impugned order dated 05.10.2023 passed by Civil Judge (Junior Division)-2/Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Buddha Nagar in Criminal Case No. 1981 of 2020 (State Vs. Kaushal Kumar Jha) arising out of Case Crime No. 1044 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 494, 504, 506 IPC,
police station Sector 49 Noida, district Gautam Buddha Nagar whereby discharge application of the revisionist has been rejected.
Kaushal Kumar Jha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106948756/
1 3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On 22.07.2024, a report was called for from the concerned Presiding Officer with regard to present status of trial of the revisionist.

Pursuant to the aforesaid order, trial Court submitted its report dated 07.08.2024 mentioning therein that the accused is not appearing before the trial Court,
therefore, charge could not be framed against him and bailable warrant against him has been issued on 05.08.2024.

4. Learned counsel for the revisionist, after advancing some arguments and on putting certain query by the Court, gave up his challenge to the aforesaid impugned order dated 05.10.2023 against the revisionist and confined his submission requesting to grant some protection to the revisionist to surrender before the concerned court below.

Learned counsel for the revisionist further stated at the bar that he is not pressing any other prayer made in this revision on merits and prayed that a direction may be issued to the concerned court below to consider and decide the bail application of the revisionist expeditiously.

5. Learned A.G.A. representing the State of U.P. submits that in case the revisionist is not pressing the relief as sought for by him on merits and wants to surrender before the concerned court below,
he has no objection if the Court grants protection to him for a short period.
6. In view of the above, the relief as sought for by the revisionist in the instant criminal revision is hereby refused.

7. However, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the revisionist,
it is directed that the revisionist shall surrender before the concerned court below within two weeks from today and in case applies for bail, the bail application of the revisionist shall be disposed of expeditiously by the court below in accordance with law and keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
8.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the period of two weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the revisionist before the concerned court below, whichever is earlier, he shall not be arrested in the above case.
9. With the above observations and directions, the instant criminal revision is disposed of.
